label: Ervin House — provisional district scenario
scope: 435 districts indexed; numerical House model WITHHELD for the 173 redrawn-map districts until current-boundary vote baselines are sourced. Cook ratings are qualitative and never converted to fictional D-R margins.

method.formula: Unchanged districts: House 2022/2024 votes vs national House margins, dated generic ballot and candidate-compatible district polls; GA/NY use 2024 only where 2022 lines are non-comparable. No federal Senate/presidential error applied. For 2026-redrawn districts, numeric old-map forecasts withheld; documented Cook rating if available.

inputs.status: secondary compilation, not independently verified current DDHQ publisher output
verified Silver Bulletin average, not likely-voter adjusted 9.2

genericBallot.note: Dated Nov 2 publisher-specific snapshot, not a claim of Nov 3 refresh. DDHQ input is secondary.

historicalReturns.source: MIT Election Data and Science Lab 1976–2024, public domain via electiondata.dev

polling.source: The New York Times CC BY 4.0 polling index as summarized at PeoplesPoll; original linked releases; RCP latest polls
polling.note: Archive shows only subset of all published surveys; a published survey count is not the number of rows displayed.

method.specialCaveat: Alaska ranked-choice and top-two/all-party California contests require contest-specific interpretation. Margins only compare identifiable D and R survey respondents; model cannot simulate RCV transfer or same-party elections.
method.uncertainty: Sensitivity width in margin points, not calibrated probability/confidence interval.
